blocks.prompt: 2 In a culture, there were 1000 bacteria initially and were found to be 900 after five hours. Use differential equation to find the number of bacteria 7 hours later.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bacteria ki aabadi ka sawal hai, lekin is dafa aabadi ghat rahi hai: 1000 se 900.
Aabadi ke badalne ki raftar maujooda tadaad ke proportional hoti hai, aur ghatne ki wajah se minus: \(\frac{dN}{dt} = -kN\), \(k > 0\).
Diya kya hai? \(N(0) = 1000\) aur \(N(5) = 900\).
Find kya karna hai? \(N(7)\).
Plan: equation hal karein, pehli condition se constant, doosri se \(k\), phir \(t = 7\) rakhein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(N(0) = 1000\), \(N(5) = 900\) (\(t\) ghanton mein).
Maloom karna: \(N(7)\).
Tareeqa: decay model \(\frac{dN}{dt} = -kN\), jo separable hai (bilkul Example 10 ki tarah).

Differential equation hal karein
\[\int\dfrac{dN}{N} = -\int k\,dt\]
\[\ln|N| = -kt + C_1\]
\[N = ce^{-kt}\]
Kyun: variables alag kiye, integrate kiya (\(\int\frac{dN}{N} = \ln|N|\)), phir dono taraf \(e\) liya. Constant \(e^{C_1}\) ko \(c\) keh diya.

\(N(0) = 1000\) lagayein
\[1000 = ce^{0} \Rightarrow c = 1000\]
\[N = 1000e^{-kt}\]
Kyun: \(e^{0} = 1\), is liye \(c\) hamesha shuru wali tadaad hoti hai.

\(N(5) = 900\) se \(k\) nikalein
\[900 = 1000e^{-5k}\]
\[e^{-5k} = 0.9\]
\[-5k = \ln 0.9\]
\[k = \tfrac{1}{5}\ln\tfrac{10}{9} \approx 0.02107\]
Kyun: 1000 se divide kiya, phir dono taraf \(\ln\) liya. \(\ln 0.9\) negative hai, is liye \(-\ln 0.9 = \ln\frac{10}{9}\) positive hai aur \(k\) positive aaya.
Dhyan dein: \(k\) negative aaye to model ka sign check karein.

\(N(7)\) nikalein
\[N(7) = 1000e^{-7k}\]
\[= 1000\left(e^{-5k}\right)^{7/5}\]
\[= 1000(0.9)^{1.4}\]
\[\approx 862.86\]
Kyun: \(e^{-7k}\) ko \((e^{-5k})^{7/5}\) likha, aur \(e^{-5k} = 0.9\) humein bilkul theek maloom hai. Is tarah \(k\) ko round karne ki ghalti se bach gaye. Bacteria poore number mein hote hain, is liye taqreeban 863.

Tasdeeq
\[1000e^{-0.02107(7)} \approx 1000e^{-0.1475} \approx 862.9\]
Tadaad ghatti ja rahi hai: 5 ghante par 900, 7 ghante par taqreeban 863 \(\checkmark\). Do tareeqon se ek hi jawab aaya.
